title: REQ · Gameplay scene fills the viewport and story text sits in a centered dialog
summary: GameLayout drops the right sidebar so the scene is full-screen and the story slot renders in a centered overlay dialog.
description: Context: GameLayout.tsx uses grid-cols md:[3fr_1fr] with an aside drawer and Story toggle button. Desired behavior: the scene main fills the viewport and the story prop renders inside a centered dialog overlay. Expected result: text appears centered over a full-screen scene. Why: the requested indie-game look.
acceptance_criteria: Given GameLayout renders scene, header and story, when inspected, then no aside element exists and the main scene container has class h-screen w-full.
Given GameLayout renders, when inspected, then the story node is inside an element with data-testid story-dialog and class sf-dialog that is centered and the scene stays mounted.

in_scope: Removing the sidebar and drawer toggle from GameLayout

technical_constraints: The dialog wrapper must be pointer-events-none with a pointer-events-auto dialog so scene objects stay clickable
Scene stays rendered by App through the scene prop
definition_of_done: Sidebar path removed and dialog layout unit tests pass
non_functional: Dialog max height 60vh and scrolls internally
